invariant: i ≤ s.toList.length ∧ (ok = true ↔ ∀ k, k < i → s.toList[k]! = s.toList[0]!)

lemmas.name: allsame_pairwise
lemmas.statement: ∀ (l : List Char), (∀ k, k < l.length → l[k]! = l[0]!) → List.Pairwise (· = ·) l
lemmas.proof:
by intro l h
  apply List.pairwise_of_forall_mem_list
  intro a ha b hb
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := (Refine.mem_iff_idx l a).mp ha
  obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := (Refine.mem_iff_idx l b).mp hb
  rw [h i hi, h j hj]

lemmas.name: allsame_not
lemmas.statement: ∀ (l : List Char), ¬ (∀ k, k < l.length → l[k]! = l[0]!) → l ≠ [] ∧ l.any (fun x => decide (x ≠ l[0]!)) = true
lemmas.proof:
by intro l h
  push_neg at h
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hne⟩ := h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h0; subst h0; simp at hk
  · rw [List.any_eq_true]
    refine ⟨l[k]!, ?_, by simpa using hne⟩
    rw [getElem!_pos l k hk]; exact List.getElem_mem hk
